text:
lena: Day 2 check-in — quick status: installed dev image, ran unit tests, hit a couple of access snags.

lena: What I did: pulled the onboarding repo, followed README, built containers, and spun up local stack. Ran `make test` — most tests passed.

lena: Blockers: can't `docker login` to our internal registry (403), and my VPN keeps dropping, which breaks gcloud auth. Wifi seems flaky in the new desk area.

lena: Today: need registry creds or perm fix, stable VPN so I can push images and finish the sample PR. Also trying to get CI token for playground project.

sam: Hey @lena — welcome again! Can you paste the exact `docker login` error? Also which OS/version are you on?

lena: error: `Error response from daemon: denied: requested access to the resource is denied`

lena: macOS 12.6, Docker Desktop 4.20.1. VPN is OpenConnect + company cert.

devops-bot: @sam FYI — registry write access for user lena not found. Suggested action: add `dev-team` role to lena or request one-off grant.

sam: thanks bot. @devops please add `dev-team` to lena, or I can open a quick ticket. Which is faster?

devops-bot: Updating ACLs usually <30m during business hours. I'll queue it now.

jen: @lena for VPN drops — did you get the machine cert provisioned? If not, re-run `scripts/setup-vpn.sh` and share logs. If it still drops, file an infra ticket and tag me.

lena: re-running now... output shows `cert not found` when hitting the cert endpoint.

sam: @lena hold on, I just checked the onboarding sheet — your machine serial was missed in the cert job. @mike from infra can you add serial 4C:5D:6E:7F?

mike: done. I pushed the cert job; you should be able to `scripts/setup-vpn.sh` in ~5 mins. LMK if not.

lena: tried again — VPN connected, much better. :relieved:

lena: reattempting `docker login`... still 403.

devops-bot: Registry ACL update applied for lena. Permissions: read/write granted.

lena: nice — `docker login` now successful. Pulled/pushed a test image. :tada:

lena: CI token: tried to request via console but hit 2FA portal redirect loop.

jen: @lena can you check that your authenticator app is registered? If not, use backup codes in the 2FA doc or ping security to reset MFA.

kate: quick note — onboarding sync at 3pm today if you want to run through perm checks and the first PR flow. Helps to squash any remaining access quirks.

lena: I'll join. Thanks everyone — most blockers cleared. Next up: open a tiny sample PR to exercise CI and deployment workflow.

sam: ping me on the PR for a quick review. Welcome aboard! :wave:
